post.description:
Retroactive pass. Streams one JSON line per container pass —
a backfill can run for minutes and the operator who asked should
watch it, not wait on a silent request.

put.description:
Opaque UI blob; whole-document last-write-wins. Atomic
write so a crash can't corrupt it.

ArenaSummaryOut.title: ArenaSummaryOut
ArenaSummaryOut.description:
One derived group row: an arena exists iff a job names it,
so there is nothing to create or delete — only to read.

HostSettings.title: HostSettings
HostSettings.description:
Per-host scheduling settings.

`active` is operator intent (set via PATCH /settings); `alive`
is an infrastructure fact auto-flipped by the docker-events
stream. Dispatch requires both.

NotifySettings.title: NotifySettings
NotifySettings.description: Live-patchable; the manager re-reads every field per event.

ReadoutAggregate.title: ReadoutAggregate
ReadoutAggregate.description: Job-level roll-up of one readout's values.

ReadoutSettings.title: ReadoutSettings
ReadoutSettings.description:
Only the retroactive pass has knobs; the live path has none to
have — it is the worker's own process doing its own work.

RetryDoneErrRequest.title: RetryDoneErrRequest
RetryDoneErrRequest.description:
Empty body = retry every done_err instance. `instance_ids`
overrides the host/since filters.

SettingsPatch.title: SettingsPatch
SettingsPatch.description:
Partial update; unknown fields are rejected, not dropped —
a typo'd knob must 422, not silently no-op.
